scope: v2 posttraining worker implementation and bounded calibration/recovery; not a trained-v2 strength claim

protocol.teacher: MaxN depth 3, every legal root action, heuristic reply beam width 4, canonical terminal discrete area
protocol.optimizer: Full-batch Adam, warm start from v1 weights, independent optimizer state, weak L2 anchor to v1
protocol.selection: Paired development mean win-share delta, then validation cross-entropy, then earlier epoch
protocol.final_arena: Independent; neither its seeds nor results are used by this worker

calibration.boundary: Local CPU calibration at plies 0,4,8, not extrapolated from only the smallest board.

checks: Forced exit inside an in-flight generation episode, optimization and an in-flight development game
Resumed checkpoint, action history, RNG, samples, Adam state, candidates and development outcomes exactly match clean execution
Completed episode files retain their modification times on a completed-run resume
PAUSE, STOP and budget yield return 75 with distinct statuses
Duplicate lease contention returns 78 without overwriting owner's progress
Config drift and completed-checkpoint corruption return 78
MaxN scores all legal root moves and preserves state even on injected exception
Terminal win shares derive from canonical discrete territory area
